field_path_notation: Dot-separated object keys; [] selects each list item; {key} selects values under arbitrary object keys. Types are JSON types, array<T> for item types, and T|null for nullable values. optional:true permits a path to be absent. stable:true marks removals and type changes as breaks; stable:false reports them as notices; stable:'type' marks type changes as breaks and reports other changes as notices.
